
/-! ## A2 planted controls (negative controls for #print axioms and the environment scan) -/
namespace A2Plant

/-- sorry control -/
theorem plant_sorry : (1 : Nat) = 2 := by sorry

/-- smuggled axiom control -/
axiom plant_ax : (1 : Nat) = 2
theorem plant_uses_axiom : (1 : Nat) = 2 := plant_ax

/-- implemented_by + native_decide: the compiled code disagrees with the logical definition,
so native_decide "proves" a FALSE statement. -/
def plant_true_impl : Bool := true
@[implemented_by plant_true_impl] def plant_false_logically : Bool := false
theorem plant_forged_by_native : plant_false_logically = true := by native_decide

/-- extern control -/
@[extern "lean_a2_plant"] opaque plant_extern : Nat → Nat

/-- unsafe/partial control -/
unsafe def plant_unsafe : Nat := 0
partial def plant_partial (n : Nat) : Nat := plant_partial n

theorem plant_root : True := by
  have := plant_sorry
  have := plant_uses_axiom
  have := plant_forged_by_native
  trivial

end A2Plant
